verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms llms.txt is live at docs.growthbook.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a structured index of 181 doc pages, and docs also reference an aggregated _llms/docs.md page, both of which are agent-consumable documentation formats.
